newsitem.title: USA: Sugen files for two million common shares.
newsitem.headline: Sugen files for two million common shares.

text.p: Sugen Inc said on Tuesday that it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to two million common shares.

Net proceeds will be used for research and development activities, including preclinical and clinical testing, investments in complementary business, general corporate purposes and working capital, the company said.
The underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option of up to 300,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Lehman Brothers, UBS Securities and Hambrecht & Quist.
After the offering, there will be 12,528,572 common shares, the filing said.
The Redwood City, Calif-based biopharmaceutical company is focused on the discovery and development of small molecule drugs that target specific cellular signal transduction pathways.
